principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is responsible for both calculating the area and outputting the result, which are considered separate responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the area calculation logic from the output formatting logic, perhaps by creating a new class for outputting results.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class needs changes if new shapes (e.g., Rectangle, Triangle) are added, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use an interface for shapes that defines a method to calculate the area, allowing the AreaCalculator to work with any shape that implements this interface without needing modification.
